#49ers RB Christian McCaffrey (thigh) is questionable to return.

#Jets star RB Breece Hall, attempting to return from a quad strain after missing three games, is unlikely to play today, sources say. He may work out to see if he can go, but Hall hasn’t been a full participant yet. It's a bit early.

Rams are optimistic that WR Puka Nacua, who is questionable for Sunday’s game due to a calf injury, will play vs. the Raiders. Nacua was feeling better Saturday and, as one source said, “as long as there aren’t any setbacks, we feel good about him being available to play.” https://t.co/mI22MZNcCj
#Seahawks defenders LB Uchenna Nwosu (hip) and S Nick Emmanwori (hip) are both listed as questionable and both expected to go, sources say.
#Broncos star CB Pat Surtain II, who has missed the last two games with an ankle injury, is unlikely to play today, source says. But there’s a good chance he’s back next week.
#Browns S Grant Delpit cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol and will play today. Meanwhile, CB Denzel Ward will warm up and see if he can go. Ward is questionable with a hand injury.
#AZCardinals S Budda Baker (groin/illness) is listed as questionable and expected to play against the #Broncos, source says.
#Falcons DE Za’Darius Smith (neck) and DT Gervon Dexter Sr. (hamstring) are listed as questionable and both are expected to go, sources say. Much less optimism for Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder).

The Rays lead Game 2 of the World Series 4-0 and there is one out in the first. An error and a pair of singles scored two runs, and Liam Hicks took Logan Henderson way out to make it 4-0. The Rays lost a close one in Game 1. They are making it clear they will not roll over.
